Reasons for a new fence

The best fence starts with what you need it to do.

Material, height, gates and layout all follow from how you use the yard.

The yard needs privacy

Create a clearer boundary between your outdoor space and nearby properties.

A dog needs a safe boundary

Choose a height and layout suited to the yard and the dog's size.

An old fence is failing

Leaning posts, loose panels and rot may make replacement more practical than repairs.

A pool area needs a barrier

Plan a fence and gates around local safety requirements.

The front boundary looks unclear

A lower decorative fence can define the property without closing it in.

A side gate is missing

Add practical access for bins, lawn equipment or backyard work.

Questions

Before you book

Do I need a property survey?

A clear boundary is important. We can discuss what records or markings are needed for your property.

Which fence material lasts longest?

Each material has different maintenance, appearance and cost. We explain the tradeoffs during the estimate.

Can you remove the old fence?

Old fence removal can be included after we review the material, length and access.

Do I need my neighbor's permission?

That depends on where the fence sits and local rules. It is wise to confirm the boundary and discuss shared lines before work starts.
